Clyde Veterinary Group was formed in 2003 to provide best in industry standards of veterinary care, delivered by three distinct teams: Small Animal, Farm and Equine. This allows us to focus on exactly what our clients and their animals need, and to train our teams to the highest standards.

We have purpose built premises at Lanark Market, a site that we have extended and developed three times since. Our Lanark branch also includes our equine referral hospital, while we added our Stirling Market branch for our farm and equine teams in 2014. 

Welcome to our YouTube channel! Keep a look out for new videos from all 3 of our departments soon! Don't forget to subscribe so when we upload a new video, you'll be the first to find out!
